title: clinopodium tenue
intro: Clinopodium tenue, commonly known as narrow-leaved wild basil, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Clinopodium tenue include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects. The plant's bioactive compounds may also exhibit hepatoprotective and cardioprotective activities, making it a subject of interest in modern herbal medicine.
